facts.scope_guard: The SPD vision is area guidance and is not a single planning permission, updated brownfield total or exact legal parcel.

scope_guards: The wider CI range of 1,844 to 3,344 homes is retained as a range and not summed.
The 131-home and 245-home applications are separate component sites.
The 376 component-home arithmetic is not treated as wider-area consent or added to the range.
The 3,500-home SPD vision is area guidance and is not added to current structured fields.
S106 deadlines and committee resolutions are not treated as final notices without direct evidence.
Industrial floorspace and consultation metrics are not dwelling capacity.
Mixed ownership and a point with blank geometry do not establish one title or synthetic site union.
No score or promotion is written without final notices, exact title relations and executed overlays.
